Its added line explicitly says f^{-1}(s) a n pts, with no equality identifying n with the order of G and no total-splitting phrase. The concluding statement says the U'_g (g not equal to e) are tous isomorphes à T''=T-f^{-1}(s); the condition is g not equal to e, with no stabilizer clause.
